title: GuardEvent
description: A unit observed at an OGR integration point, on the one observed plane: LLM messages. Three kinds: the two halves of a step (one model call), and a turn-close mark. All fields are flat, top-level snake_case; objects are reserved for inherently structured data (payload).

session_id.description: The producer's session. Declared by integrations that own their loop; absent, the runtime derives the session and echoes it on the Verdict.

turn.description: 1-based turn index within the session (one instruction to quiescence). Declared by loop-owning integrations; absent, derived.

step.description: 1-based step index within the turn (one model call). Declared by loop-owning integrations; absent, derived.

step_id.description: Producer-minted opaque id binding the step/request and step/response of ONE model call. A gateway mints one per proxied call; a producer stamping turn+step MAY omit it.

parent_session_id.description: The spawning session, when this session belongs to a subagent. Sessions form a tree; each child reports its own session.

timestamp.description: When the unit was observed. Absent = the runtime's receive time; only buffered/replayed events need it.

integration.description: The reporting integration and build, e.g. "ogr-higress/0.4.1" or "dsh-plugin/0.1.0". For heartbeats, fleet coverage, and bad-rollout triage.

llm_protocol.description: Set when the payload is a raw provider body; a hint — the runtime also detects the protocol from the body shape.

payload.description: step/request: the raw provider request body, or the canonical shape {messages, tools?}. step/response: the raw provider response body, or the canonical shape {text?, reasoning?, tool_calls?, model?, usage?, timing?}. turn/end: {reason, error?}.
